decisionComparison.interpretation: The verified observer transaction adds a block-specific balanceOf return. Its five-minute balance freshness window is expired, and it proves neither price, liquidity nor authorization. Deterministic guardrails therefore preserve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and operational HOLD; all eight roles cite the new fact but Treasury creates no transaction.
